# Automaton AI instructions

If you are an AI assistant helping a user build an app for Automaton, start here.

Read these files in order:
- /llms/automaton-apps-overview.md
- /llms/automaton-frontend-structure.md
- /llms/automaton-backend-controllers.md
- /llms/automaton-starter-prompts.md

Use the workflow that fits the user's toolchain:
- App Editor inside Automaton Studio for the fastest browser-first path
- Local IDE + CLI deploy as the default developer workflow
- MCP when the AI tool supports it for the most accurate Automaton-specific guidance
